title: Concrete strength gain with ln(age)
intro: Compressive strength (MPa) of cylinders from one concrete mix, tested at ages from 1 to 90 days. Strength rises quickly at first and then more and more slowly, so a straight line in age fits badly (R² = 0.739, with an arch in its residuals). With **Transform x** set to the natural log, the model Strength = b₀ + b₁·ln(age) is linear in ln(age): R² = 0.989, σ̂ = 1.24 MPa, and the residuals show no pattern. The fitted curve is drawn back in days. Predicted strength at 60 days: 39.3 MPa.
